title: CaptureItem
description: What one capture adapter returns for one page. The ingest endpoint validates against this, and any adapter that produces it is accepted. Versioned: bump `version` when a field changes meaning, and keep the old adapter working until the new one ships.

pageKind.description: 'detail' for one posting, 'search' for a list of postings.

url.description: Canonical URL of the posting, never the URL with a session token.

externalId.description: The platform's own id. Preferred dedupe key; the fallback is company|title|city.

salaryText.description: As shown on the page. Parsing into a range is the backend's job, not the adapter's.

jdText.description: The posting body, one line per line as shown.
